entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, a cruel and ruthless Argivian artificer who came to control western Terisiare and never became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Echoverse Mishra
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Mishra, who ascended into a planeswalker and gifted Karn an artificial spark.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's older brother, an artificer who became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Excavator to whom the brothers were apprenticed; she died caught between the powers of the two stones.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A young Fallaji who befriended Mishra at Tocasia's camp and later helped him.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Inventor of the Staff of Zegon who apprenticed herself to Mishra and killed the Qadir at Kroog.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Title of the leader of the Suwwardi; the first was slain by the dragon engine, his son succeeded him, and Ashnod killed the latter at Kroog.

entities.name: Kayla
entities.description: Convinced by Mishra to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon summoned by the Brotherhood of Gix who sought to corrupt Mishra and later took him.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Priests who summoned Gix and became Mishra's council and artificer forces.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: A militant faction of the Fallaji that captured and enslaved Mishra.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Desert tribes of the Western Desert whom Mishra united.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's half of the Thran powerstone, which made things stronger than normally possible.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's half of the powerstone, which sapped strength from artifacts and living creatures.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: A giant mechanical dragon that rose from the sands and which Mishra found he could control.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A large Thran city named by Urza, where the brothers found the great machine and the powerstone.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The long and bloody war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Mishra's attack on the Yotian capital Kroog.

entities.name: Battle at Argoth
entities.description: The final battle in which Urza destroyed Mishra and the sentient forest.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island the brothers fought over in the last part of the war.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Urza's Phyrexian companion who theorized Mishra's flesh was used to create her.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian lord to whom Urza bowed during Apocalypse.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The golden golem created by Mishra in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Opened the Starfield Orb left by Urza in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Starfield Orb
entities.description: Orb left by Urza containing a pocket dimension of his cabin on Gulmany.

events.summary: Mishra and Urza are born; years later their father dies after sending them to apprentice with Tocasia.
Tocasia, Urza and Mishra fly to the Thran city Koilos, find a great machine, and an explosion leaves each brother holding half of the powerstone.
events.quote: each brother was holding a half of the great stone in their hand

events.summary: Mishra confronts Urza while drunk and tries to take his stone; Tocasia is killed caught between the stones' powers and Mishra flees.
events.quote: she was caught between the powers surging from the two stones and died

events.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra, enslave him and take his Weakstone.
events.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi, a militant faction of the Fallaji, who enslaved him

events.summary: Hajar has Mishra set as tutor to the Qadir's son.
A mechanical dragon rises and slays the Qadir; Mishra retrieves the Weakstone and discovers he can control the dragon.
events.quote: Mishra found he could directly control it instead

events.summary: The new Qadir promotes Mishra to raki and they set out to unify the Fallaji; Mishra meets Ashnod.
events.quote: promoted Mishra from rakiq to raki

events.summary: Mishra seduces Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone at the Kroog peace talks; Urza reclaims it and Mishra flees.
events.quote: he convinced Kayla to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone

events.summary: With Urza away hunting him, Mishra attacks Kroog; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra becomes leader of the Fallaji and the Butcher of Kroog.
events.quote: Ashnod killed the Qadir, leading to Mishra succeeding him as leader of the Fallaji

events.summary: Around 36 AR Gix is summoned to Mishra's Fortress, is burned by the Weakstone and decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
events.quote: seeking instead to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix becomes Mishra's council, banishes Ashnod and helps take Terisia City.
Mishra, weakened by lung disease, listens to the Brotherhood's body-modification practices and dismisses Hajar.
events.quote: dismissing loyal Hajar from the room to speak with the priests privately

events.summary: Mishra is turned over to Gix and compleated before Argoth.
events.quote: Mishra was turned over to Gix and compleated

events.summary: At Argoth Urza reveals Mishra as a construct of flesh and Phyrexian metal and destroys him and the forest; Urza ascends as a planeswalker.
events.quote: Urza released an enormous burst of power that destroyed both Mishra and the sentient forest

events.summary: During Apocalypse Urza meets a tormented body of Mishra deep in Phyrexia, whose nature is uncertain.
events.quote: he met the body of Mishra deep in the Center of Phyrexia

events.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Mishra and Xantcha.
events.quote: constructs of Mishra and Xantcha , who greeted Jodah

events.summary: In the Echoverse Mishra's life is saved by Karn, to whom he gifts an artificial planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Mishra gifted Karn an artificial planeswalker spark

relations.quote: Mishra was the brother of Urza .

relations.note: The brothers were apprenticed to her.

relations.quote: he and Urza fought a long and bloody war

relations.note: Mishra was turned over to Gix and compleated.
relations.quote: Mishra was turned over to Gix and compleated

relations.note: Befriended him at the camp and helped him.
relations.quote: a young Fallaji who had befriended Mishra at Tocasia 's camp

relations.note: In the Echoverse, Karn was Mishra's creation.
relations.quote: his creation, the golden golem Karn
